caption:
Walking at their pace

Walking at their pace.

People walking side by side fall into the same rhythm without noticing, and the match tends to make the talk feel closer.

For whoever slows down for the slow one.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. Two small block figures with white eyes, an amber one in the middle and a light blue one on the left. The amber one hurries ahead to the right, turns around with wide eyes and a bubble says ready. The blue one narrows its eyes and a bubble says slow today. The amber one walks back and a bubble says I'll slow down. Then both walk to the right together, slowly, with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: me walking at their pace. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
